goal: Measure HELUT assignment generation, input packing, synchronized graph execution, strict output decode, and canonical digest as adjacent subphases of the already accepted paired end-to-end scope. Attribute the host-side gap before optimizing it; no favorable result is required.

predecessor.verdict: functional and preregistered protocol PASS; no paired crossover through B=65536

changeFromPredecessor.instrumentationOnly: Read adjacent CFAbsoluteTime timestamps after assignment generation, input packing, synchronized graph execution, strict output decode, and canonical digest; reserve phase sample arrays outside the timed loop; emit raw phase samples and reconciliation residuals after timing. The existing refill closure returns the assignment timestamp, so its return overhead remains inside the input-pack interval.

pairedHELUTScope: Assignment-mask regeneration and writes to every preallocated input buffer, including clk=0, through synchronized MPSGraph execution, strict output traversal/decode, and ordered FNV-1a digest. Allocation, graph compilation, cold specialization, and correctness comparison remain excluded.
adjacentPhases: output traversal and strict decode into the existing nested value matrix

reconciliation.method: For each trial, sum the five adjacent deltas derived from the same six timestamps and compare that sum with digestEnd-start.
reconciliation.medianCaveat: Independently selected phase medians are not required to sum to the total median; raw per-trial reconciliation is authoritative.

optimizationSelectionRule.rule: Rank assignment, input pack, decode, and digest by their five-sample median. Optimize the largest recoverable host phase first without moving work outside the paired boundary. Graph execution is recorded but remains a separate kernel lever.

candidateByWinningPhase.decode: Remove owning one-element decode arrays while preserving strict degree-one validation and canonical output order; prefer a flat representation only if needed.
candidateByWinningPhase.digest: Replace repeated withUnsafeBytes closures with an explicit inlined four-byte little-endian FNV mix while preserving every hashed field and byte.
candidateByWinningPhase.inputPack: Specialize the degree-one constant-fill write loop while still regenerating assignments and rewriting every input including clk.
candidateByWinningPhase.assignment: Hoist only loop-invariant arithmetic and specialize the deterministic formula while still regenerating every assignment inside the paired scope.

failurePolicy: Bank any test, digest, mapping, phase-accounting, or protocol failure. Do not discard or silently rerun an unfavorable decomposition. Do not lower B, trials, or workers. Preserve all predecessor evidence.
claimBoundary: This run attributes one release-Swift/MPSGraph paired implementation on one combinational ripple-adder fixture and one Mac16,5. Instrumentation adds clock reads and does not establish general runtime behavior.
